title: Decora Panel - Modular Panel
seoTitle: Decora Roofing Tiles - Timeless Durability & Style
description: Decora modular panels by Stellar offer unparalleled durability. Made from premium European and Canadian steel, they resist weather extremes and look new for decades.

sections.text: Attractive & elegant appearance combined with top quality make it top choice with architects, contractors and homeowners alike.

sections.html:
Modern methods of construction or renovation of homes & buildings together with modern architectural trends require rooﬁng system with modern features that visually complement the appearance of the building while providing exceptional lifespan with no maintenance.

Because of its dense proﬁle and special manufacturing techniques Decora tile is extremely strong, suitable for both new construction and rerooﬁng projects. Attractive & elegant appearance combined with top quality make it top choice with architects, contractors and homeowners alike.

Decora modular steel tile has all those attributes and more.

Decora roof tile panels are lightweight for ease of transportation and placement onto the roof, thus making it ideal for 2 persons rooﬁng crews! One standard palette can be loaded with 3000 sq feet or over 300 panels, – substantial savings on transport and storage. Decora Tile 350 module with covering width of 1160 mm, needs fewer straps/ battens and screws, translating into savings and shorter installation time, thu s translating into proﬁts. Proven track record for easy and quick installation and assembly. Stellar Tile design results in 20% less waste compared to other steel roof applications.

The AG Panel also known as the Rib Panel is a lightweight, exposed fastener roofing system that is most popular for agricultural buildings, storage facilities, and canopies. With ease of installation in mind, the AG Panel system is a straightforward installation with clean look and simplicity in mind.

Rudan Tile, modular steel roof panels is an innovative and unique new metal roofing product. The tiles are made of premium G90 steel, with matt crinkle look color coating with strong resistance to abrasion and corrosion. Attractive & elegant appearance combined with top quality make it top choice with architects, contractors and homeowners alike.
